verdict.rationale: Jeeves is a corporate card, payments and expense-management platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence documents only a Jeeves MCP server that external agents connect to. That is server-side capability, which belongs to a separate story and cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
